params.caption: 🎮 Darktide's Sister Novitiate class: crossbow, flamer and holy grenades Fatshark has detailed the kit of Warhammer 40,000: Darktide's next class. Sisters Novitiate get a semi-auto stake-throwing crossbow that can pin close enemies to walls, a hand flamer, a heavy chainsword, a sword and shield and the Meltagun. Before each mission they pick two "Acts of Faith", such as a Sanctification Grenade that makes tougher foes take more damage, plus buffs and healing. The DLC arrives on December 7. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 06:53 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer ⚔️ React if you're maining her · 💬 Which weapon are you trying first? #Darktide #Warhammer40K #Fatshark #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
